name: Dheja Daruna Panjalu
title: QA Engineer
tagline: Building trust in software, one test at a time.
summary: QA Engineer with over 4 years of experience in high-growth tech environments, including Shopee (Sea Labs) and Astra Life. Expert in designing and scaling automated testing frameworks for Microservices and high-traffic features. Proven track record in AI-driven testing and collaborating with international teams (Singapore/Shenzhen). Strong background in CI/CD integration, API testing, and Automation Testing using Python, Playwright, Selenium, and Robot Framework.

bullets: Owned end-to-end quality for the PDP and Rating features, building comprehensive test suites and managing the full bug/defect lifecycle with data-driven prioritization to maintain a high bar for product stability.

QA in charge of backend automation regression, streamlining weekly cycles and cutting manual overhead for production releases, while driving broader adoption of internal QA and AI-assisted testing tools to accelerate test generation, execution, and analysis across the Cart/PDP/Rating team.
Collaborated cross-functionally with engineering and product stakeholders across Singapore and Shenzhen to uphold consistent quality standards in a distributed, international environment.
Spearheaded the adoption of automation testing from the ground up, establishing a modern QA culture and owning end-to-end automation efforts across the team.
Designed, implemented, and maintained a robust CI automation pipeline on GitLab, while developing and refining test scripts in Python (Selenium) and Robot Framework.
Partnered closely with Business Analysts to translate their requirements into effective automated test coverage, ensuring quality was built into every stage of delivery.
Expanded automation test coverage while mentoring fellow QA engineers in developing their own automation scripts, strengthening the team's overall testing capability.
Led scrum rituals for the QA Automation Squad, driving sprint planning and execution.
Served as code reviewer for the automation script codebase, upholding code quality and consistency across the team.
